The '''Bombardment of Haruun Kal''' was undertaken by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==The attack==
Spurred on by [[The Private Journals of Mace Windu|the records]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] made during his [[Battle of Haruun Kal/Legends|mission to the planet]], the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] bombarded the planet's surface.

==Aftermath==
In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], scholars believed that the action had killed off all [[Korun/Legends|Korunnai]]. However, as the world was represented in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]], presumably the [[Balawai]] continued to exist. As it turned out, at least three Korunnai still lived during [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], namely [[Kar Vastor]], [[Nick Rostu]], and [[Lorz Geptun]].
